mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.class_code AS classCode, tc.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_category AS courseCategory, c.course_description AS courseDescription, c.cover_image AS coverImage, c.syllabus, c.total_hours AS totalHours, c.target_audience AS targetAudience, c.prerequisites, c.skill_indicators AS skillIndicators, c.scoring_rules AS scoringRules, tc.class_name AS className, tc.instructor_id AS instructorId, instructor.real_name AS instructorName, tc.enrollment_start AS enrollmentStart, tc.enrollment_end AS enrollmentEnd, tc.start_date AS startDate, tc.end_date AS endDate, tc.location, tc.capacity, tc.fee, tc.class_status AS classStatus, tc.publish_status AS publishStatus, tc.publish_time AS publishTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_training_session ts WHERE ts.training_class_id = tc.id AND ts.is_deleted = 0) AS sessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_training_session ts WHERE ts.training_class_id = tc.id AND ts.is_deleted = 0 AND ts.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS activeSessionCount, tc.create_time AS createTime

SELECT FROM t_training_class tc JOIN t_course c ON c.id = tc.course_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_user instructor ON instructor.id = tc.instructor_id AND instructor.is_deleted = 0
tc.is_deleted = 0
AND (tc.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.class_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND tc.class_status = #{classStatus}
AND tc.publish_status = #{publishStatus}
AND (tc.instructor_id = #{instructorId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_training_session own_session WHERE own_session.training_class_id = tc.id AND own_session.instructor_id = #{instructorId} AND own_session.is_deleted = 0))
AND tc.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND tc.class_status != 'CANCELLED' AND c.status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY tc.start_date DESC, tc.create_time DESC, tc.id DESC
